name: sortable-list
blurb: Drag-to-reorder list with checkbox completion and spring-animated delete action.
description: List component using Framer Motion's Reorder primitive for drag-to-sort functionality. Items can be marked complete (checked) which animates a delete button. Completed items slide out when deleted. Uses a render-function pattern (renderItem) for full layout control.
use_when: Todo lists, task managers, or any interface where users reorder items by dragging.
avoid_when: Very large lists (1000+ items) — drag performance degrades significantly.
a11y: Reorder items are draggable but not keyboard-accessible for reordering. Checkboxes and delete buttons are keyboard-navigable.

props.name: renderItem
props.type: (item: Item, order: number, onCompleteItem: (id: number) => void, onRemoveItem: (id: number) => void) => ReactNode
